mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_ai_weekly_analysis_log (user_id, start_date, end_date, request_system_prompt, request_user_prompt, response_json, weekly_score, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{requestSystemPrompt}, #{requestUserPrompt}, #{responseJson}, #{weeklyScore}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM diet_ai_weekly_analysis_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_date = #{endDate} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
